Vendored copy of the OpenQASM 3 parser used by Irene.

Upstream project: https://github.com/Qiskit/openqasm3_parser
Vendored revision: 4bf2859b8e0e37a2a0f4ef5eef868b101df0f2af
Reason: keep the build fully local and free of network git dependencies.
The crates are consumed as path dependencies from crates/{oq3_lexer,oq3_source_file,oq3_syntax}.
